events.title: First Episode of Doctor Who Airs
events.description: The BBC broadcast the first episode of Doctor Who, 'An Unearthly Child', the day after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. The series follows a time-traveling alien known as the Doctor.
events.significance: Doctor Who became the longest-running science fiction television series in the world and a global cultural phenomenon, influencing generations of writers, creators, and viewers.

events.title: Life Magazine Publishes Its First Issue
events.description: Henry Luce launched the new Life magazine, reinventing it as a weekly publication focused on photojournalism. The first issue featured a cover photograph of the Fort Peck Dam in Montana by Margaret Bourke-White.
events.significance: Life pioneered large-scale photojournalism and shaped how Americans saw world events for decades, helping establish the photo essay as a major journalistic form.

events.title: First Jukebox Debuts in San Francisco
events.description: The first coin-operated music machine, a phonograph fitted with a coin mechanism by Louis Glass and William S. Arnold, was installed at the Palais Royale Saloon in San Francisco. It was known as the Nickel-in-the-Slot player.
events.significance: This invention was the forerunner of the jukebox, which became central to popular music distribution and social life in the 20th century.

events.title: Edwin Hubble Announces Galaxies Beyond the Milky Way
events.description: Astronomer Edwin Hubble's finding that the Andromeda 'nebula' was a separate galaxy far outside the Milky Way was publicly reported, based on his observations of Cepheid variable stars.
events.significance: The discovery transformed cosmology by showing that the universe was vastly larger than previously believed, leading to the understanding of an expanding universe.

events.title: Irpinia Earthquake Strikes Southern Italy
events.description: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck the Irpinia region of southern Italy, killing nearly 3,000 people and leaving hundreds of thousands homeless.
events.significance: The disaster exposed weaknesses in Italy's emergency response and building standards, prompting reforms in the country's civil protection system.
